post_title: Josper CASA Charcoal Oven Cocina - with Basque grill | Josper-Spain
post_content: The Josper Cocina is the perfect combination of two grilling systems: the closed charcoal grill of the classic Josper oven and the traditional open flame of the Basque Grill, all in one unit. The oven and grill tandem offers endless culinary possibilities in your home. Josper CASA brings the embers of the world’s top chefs to your home. Fueled entirely by charcoal, it is a sophisticated fusion of a grill and an oven in a single machine. Technology applied to grill by Josper: radiation, convection and transmission. Included accessories: stainless steel grill, poker, Josper tongs, metal brush.
